field_text_formatted.value: None of that makes either grant wrong. It makes them a trade, because the trip to Drupal is what ran those checks. If you need them, call loginWith without credentials and the old flow comes back, Drupal's login page and all. That is how I run two factor on another site. It works, but it means the full round trip every time, and making that less ugly is the next thing I want to fix.
